components.name: Pod manifest
components.description: Declares containers, image, ports and volumes

components.name: Scheduler
components.description: Selects a node and binds the Pod

components.name: Kubelet
components.description: Reconciles assigned Pod on the node

components.name: CRI runtime
components.description: Creates sandbox, pulls image and starts containers

components.name: Pod lifecycle
components.description: Pending → Running → Succeeded / Failed; restarts depend on policy

operational_steps: Submit Pod manifest to API server
API server validates and persists Pod object
Scheduler binds Pod to an eligible node
CRI creates sandbox and starts container
Observe phase, conditions, events and restart behaviour
failure_checkpoint: Image pull or container startup failure
recovery_path: Use kubectl describe pod and logs; correct image, runtime configuration or application startup.
